title: Redact Image
description: Stops a “redacted” screenshot from leaking what it hides: solid boxes only (blur and pixelation can be reversed), padded and snapped to whole pixels, placeable by drag or keyboard, suggestions from a pluggable text detector with an amber nudge for anything sensitive left uncovered, and an export flattened to a fresh PNG that is re-read to prove every box is solid, with no metadata and no aCropalypse-style data after the image end.
